0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak) are 14th in the West and 7.5 games back in the Pacific, while the Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game skid) are 12th in the East. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Paolo Banchero, with Desmond Bane day-to-day with illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Kings lost both games of their 2025-26 season series, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
